source_pdf: Chapter 15 Animal Or Vegetable Fats And Oils And Their Cleavage Products; Prepared Edible Fats; Animal Or Vegetable Waxes.pdf
extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '15011000'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '1501.10.00') per project schema. Subheading numbers in PDF (e.g., '150210') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g., '1502.10').

PDF table-chrome headers ('Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Main Notes', 'Sub-Heading Notes', 'Policy Condition', 'Export Licensing Notes', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table headers and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Section III ('ANIMAL, VEGETABLE OR MICROBIAL FATS AND OILS AND THEIR CLEAVAGE PRODUCTS; PREPARED EDIBLE FATS; ANIMAL OR VEGETABLE WAXES') appears as a section header above the Chapter 15 title; no separate Section Notes table is printed in the PDF (Section III contains only Chapter 15). section_notes captured as empty array.

PDF contains '?' characters in place of typographic quote marks in the Export Licensing Notes and tariff line 1505.00.90 policy condition (e.g., '?Shipment Clearance Certificate?', '?Health Certificate?', 'as Organic?'). These are OCR/encoding artifacts from the source PDF — preserved verbatim as they appear in the source.
Chapter Note 1 lists exclusions as inline sub-items (a) through (f). Each is captured as a separate exclusion_clause entry in exclusion_clauses array.

Heading 1505 in PDF is rendered as a single line containing both the heading row and an additional subheading row '150500' with description identical to heading title. Subheading '1505.00' captured with the printed title 'Wool grease and fatty substances derived therefrom (including lanolin)'.

Tariff line 1502.10.90 policy condition spans multiple sub-clauses including '(i) Export permitted only from APEDA registered integrated meat plants...' — captured verbatim, including the sentence about Buffalo Tallow being free.

Tariff line 1505.00.90 has TWO Notification Nos listed ('104(RE-2013)/2009-2014' and '37/2015-20') with TWO Notification Dates ('31.12.2014' and '25.10.2017'). Both pairs preserved in the policy_conditions array.

Heading 1511 ('Palm oil...') has no '151110' subheading printed in the PDF — code '15111000' (Crude oil) appears directly under heading 1511. Tariff line 1511.10.00 reconstructed under subheading 1511.10 per HS structural convention.

Heading 1512 — subheading '151220' is missing in PDF; only '151221' and '151229' appear under heading 1512. Per HS structure, 1512.21 falls under the parent '1512.2x Cotton-seed oil and its fractions' grouping but printed PDF goes directly from '151219' to '15122100' (1512.21.00) — preserved as-is.

Heading 1515 — no subheading line printed for '151510' (Linseed oil), '151520' (Olive residue oil — not present in this chapter), '151540' (Castor oil and its fractions), '151550' (Sesame), '151560' (Microbial), '151590' (Other). Subheadings reconstructed where parent codes appear (1515.11/1515.19 under Linseed parent; 1515.21/1515.29 under Maize parent; 1515.30 Castor; 1515.50 Sesame; 1515.60 Microbial; 1515.90 Other) using the codes printed in the PDF.

Heading 1518 — PDF does not print a '151800' subheading line. Tariff lines '15180011' through '15180040' belong logically to subheading '1518.00'. Reconstructed under subheading '1518.00' with the heading title.
Heading 1520 — only single tariff line '15200000' printed (Glycerol, crude). Captured under reconstructed subheading '1520.00' with heading title.

Heading 1522 — subheading '152200' printed with description 'Degras: residues resulting from the treatment of fatty substances or animal or vegetable waxes :' — title preserved verbatim including trailing colon.
Tariff line 1515.90.20 description in PDF ends with trailing comma ('neem seed oil, karanj oil, silk cotton seed oil,') — preserved verbatim.

Heading 1517 in PDF reads 'MARGARINE; EDIBLE MIXTURES OR PREPARATIONS OF ANIMAL, VEGETABLE OR MICROBIAL FATS OR OILS OR OF FRACTIONS OF DIFFERENT FATS OR OILS OF THIS CHAPTER, OTHER THAN EDIBLE FATS AND OILS OR THEIR FRACTIONS OF HEADING 1516' — note 'OTHER THAN EDIBLE' is correct per HS 2022 (heading 1516 covers hydrogenated; 1517 covers mixtures/margarine).

Heading 1517, subheading '151710' (Margarine, excluding liquid margarine) — note that tariff line 1517.10.20 ('Of vegetable origin') is not separately listed; instead three sub-codes 1517.10.21/22/29 appear directly. Preserved as printed.
Subheading 1517.90 — PDF skips intermediate '1517.90.20' line; tariff lines jump from 1517.90.10 (Sal fat) to 1517.90.30 (Imitation lard of animal origin). Preserved as printed.
No 'unit' column appears in the source PDF (Indian ITC-HS Schedule 2 Export Policy format only has Code/Description/Export Policy/Policy Condition columns). All unit fields set to null.
Export Policy and Notification details preserved in policy_conditions array (one entry per tariff line with a policy condition) and export_licensing_notes array.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover : (a) pig fat or poultry fat of heading 0209; (b) cocoa butter, fat or oil (heading 1804); (c) edible preparations containing by weight more than 15% of the products of heading 0405 (generally Chapter 21); (d) greaves (heading 2301) or residues of headings 2304 to 2306; (e) fatty acids, prepared waxes, medicaments, paints, varnishes, soap, perfumery, cosmetic or toilet preparations, sulphonated oils or other goods of Section VI; or (f) factice derived from oils (heading 4002).
Heading 1509 does not apply to oils obtained from olives by solvent extraction (heading 1510).

Heading 1518 does not cover fats or oils or their fractions, merely denatured, which are to be classified in the heading appropriate to the corresponding undenatured fats and oils and their fractions.
Soap-stocks, oil foots and dregs,stearin pitch, glycerol pitch and wool grease residuesfall in heading 1522.

chapter_subheading_notes.text: For the purposes of sub-heading 1509 30, virgin olive oil has a free acidity expressed as oleic acid not exceeding 2.0 g/ 100 g and can be distinguished from the other virgin olive oil categories according to the characteristics indicated in the Codex Alimentarius Standard 33-1981.
For the purposes of sub-headings 1514 11 and 1514 19, the expression "low erucic acid rape or colza oil" means the fixed oil which has an erucic acid content of less than 2% by weight.

export_licensing_notes.text: (i) Export of oils produced out of minor forest produce, as per table given below, even if edible; IT HS Code Item Description 15159010 Fixed Vegetable oils viz. Neutralised and Bleached Morwah Oil/fat, 15159020 Fixed vegetable oils viz. Dhup oil, Neemseed oil 15159030 Fixed vegetable oils viz. Nigerseed oil. 15159040 Fixed vegetable oils viz. Neutralised and Bleached Mango kernel 15179010 Sal Fat (Processed or Refined). 15219020 Shellac wax, whether or not coloured. 15219010 Beewax (ii) Export of organic edible oils from Custom EDI ports have been exempted from all quantitative ceilings irrespective of any existing or future restriction/ prohibition on export of their basic product (non-organic), with due certification as Organic? under the NPOP by Agricultural &Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA), New Delhi. [Notification No. 03/2015-2020 dated 19.04.2017] (iii) Export of edible oils (other than those mentioned in Note 1 above, is permitted in branded consumer packs of upto 5 Kgs, subject to a Minimum Export Price of USD 900 per MT.
